create_triple: create a TripleNode to add a subject-predicate-object triple to the triplestore
get_triples: get triples from the triplestore filtered by subject, predicate, or object
create_task: create a TaskNode entry on the agent task stack with a task object
create_chat: create a ChatNode entry to record an utterance from a speaker
create_player: create a PlayerNode entry with entity ID, name, position, pitch, and yaw
